rule: Each arrow starts near one side of the box (marked by a dashed line, or by the box edge itself when there is no dashed line) and points away from that side, into the box. In figure 4 the dashed line is near the top but the arrow points up toward the top and its head leaves the box, so it points toward that side instead of away from it.
options_check: 1: dashed line at left, arrow starts left and points right (away) - fits. 2: arrow starts at top edge and points down (away) - fits. 3: dashed line near bottom, arrow starts below it and points up (away) - fits. 4: dashed line near top, arrow points up toward the top and exits the box - breaks the rule. 5: arrow starts at bottom edge and points up (away) - fits.
